'''2014 US Nationals Day 2 Chris Terwilliger DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Vader322
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
